classification: KNOWN AVAILABILITY TRADE-OFF, NOT SECURITY REGRESSION
what_was_accepted: Both gateways require an ONLINE Core session verdict for every authenticated Torneos request. The Node gateway obtained it DB-to-DB from auth.sessions; the Edge gateway obtains it over HTTPS through the Core contract (`session` op, v1.1). Preserving the Node behaviour during a core-functions outage would require violating a constraint already decided (DB-to-DB, verdict cache / revocation window, shared Core service_role, or a new authority surface on Core).
approved_remote_semantics: every authenticated Torneos request requires a CURRENT Core session verdict
never serve with a stale session
revocation / ban / soft-delete stay immediate (next request)
no DB-to-DB between Torneos and Core
documented_as: known availability dependency: the availability of the Core Edge Functions runtime (torneos-core-contract) is on the per-request critical path of every session-gated Torneos request, in addition to GoTrue and the Core database that were already on the Node gateway's critical path
alternatives_note: not to be implemented in Phase 3B; A/B degrade revocation, C/D/E expand trust or open a new Core surface, F does not restore equivalence

basis.note: the decision is bound to these evidence values, not to file bytes: if a re-run of d1.test.mjs changes any of them, summarize.py marks the decision stale and Phase 3B falls back to BLOCKED until it is re-confirmed
